prompts.title: Recent Form Split
prompts.prompt: 9:16 vertical sports card, lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles. Palette: GoatLab charcoal #101412 background, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 emphasis, slate #8ca6bf secondary structure. Editorial variant: kinetic typography and rhythmic emphasis. Start with CA Osasuna and Real Racing Club de Santander as two large Spanish team names stacked in the upper half, with small Spanish labels 'Victorias', 'Empates' and 'Derrotas' appearing as typographic beats, not as a chart. No statistical axes, no sample claims and no invented match events; only a tiny source credit 'Fuente: Bzzoiro' at the top edge. Motion: names lock in on a sharp beat, then the three words pulse in sequence; the focal point is the word with the strongest tempo emphasis, rendered in lime. Camera does a slow vertical push. Transition: the kinetic words compress into a thin slate line that becomes the statistical chart baseline. Statistical variant: grouped vertical count bars for each team, three bars per team for wins, draws and losses, shared zero baseline and a common count scale in partidos. On-screen Spanish labels: 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas'; team labels 'CA Osasuna' and 'Real Racing Club de Santander'; unit 'partidos'. All bar values are text placeholders: CA Osasuna wins {{home.wins}}, draws {{home.draws}}, losses {{home.losses}}; Real Racing wins {{away.wins}}, draws {{away.draws}}, losses {{away.losses}}. Source/sample footer: 'Fuente: Bzzoiro · Muestra CA Osasuna {{home.n}} partidos · Muestra Real Racing {{away.n}} partidos'. If sample sizes differ, show a small Spanish note 'Muestras distintas'; do not convert counts into rates. Entry: bars rise from baseline in stagger. Main comparison: the grouped bars resolve side by side. Emphasis: the largest count in each group is highlighted in lime by the renderer; other bars warm white with slate edges. Camera: slight top-down settle. Transition: a lime wipe reveals the footer. Exit: bars collapse toward the baseline and leave a clean charcoal field above the subtitle zone.
